items.name: b11851
items.body:
<details open>

mtmd : lfm2 resize matches torchvision (#30943)

* mtmd : lfm2 bilinear resize matches torchvision

Lfm2VlImageProcessor and d1-omni vision.py resize uint8 images with
torchvision (antialias=True). That is Pillow's algorithm, except that the
weights are int16 with as many fractional bits as the largest weight allows,
where Pillow uses 22 bits. The Pillow port was 1-2 levels off on about 1% of
the values of the d1-omni and LFM2.5-VL crops.

RESIZE_ALGO_BILINEAR_TORCH rounds the weights of the Pillow port to that
precision and scales them back to 22 bits, which gives the output of
torchvision with the same passes, and "bilinear" maps to it for LFM2 and
d1-omni. Other models keep the Pillow algorithms.

* mtmd : lfm2 bicubic resize matches torchvision

Lfm2VlImageProcessor resizes with torchvision for the bicubic checkpoints too
(d1-3B, LFM2-VL), so "bicubic" maps to RESIZE_ALGO_BICUBIC_TORCH for LFM2: the
Pillow bicubic filter (a = -0.5, as torchvision with antialias) with the int16
weights of torchvision. The Pillow port was 1-2 levels off on about 0.25% of
the values of the d1-3B crops.

* use bitfield, add hparams setter

---------

Co-authored-by: Xuan Son Nguyen <son@huggingface.co>

</details>

items.body:
<details open>

mtmd : add Soprano TTS support (#28607)

Add Soprano-80M and Soprano-1.1-80M (https://huggingface.co/ekwek/Soprano-1.1-80M)
as an audio generation model: a Qwen3 backbone plus a Vocos decoder that runs
as a gen-only mmproj.

- convert: detect Soprano checkpoints and export the backbone as qwen3 and the
  decoder.pth Vocos weights as the mmproj
- vocab: add the soprano pre-tokenizer (lowercase, whitespace collapse,
  per-digit split, [UNK] fallback)
- mtmd: add the Vocos graph and ISTFT, allow loading a gen-only mmproj for
  Soprano and include the gen-audio context in mtmd_get_memory_usage
- mtmd-helper: add the Soprano pipeline; the decoder runs over the whole
  utterance, so stream mode sends the audio in one chunk after flush()
- tts: document Soprano usage

Assisted-by: Codex
Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5.5

</details>

items.name: b11847
items.body:
<details open>

hip: fix bf16 WMMA operand vector type for gfx11/gfx12 (#30885)

The __builtin_amdgcn_wmma_f32_16x16x16_bf16_w32 (and _gfx12) builtins
take their A/B operands as vectors of short (_ExtVector<16, short> /
_ExtVector<8, short>), not __bf16. Declaring the fragments as
ext_vector_type(N) __bf16 fails to compile:

  error: cannot initialize a parameter of type 'short
  __attribute__((ext_vector_type(16)))' with an lvalue of type 'const
  bf16x16_t' (vector of 16 '__bf16' values)

short and __bf16 are both 16-bit and the value is only ever passed to
the builtin via reinterpret_cast over raw bytes, so changing the element
type is bit-identical. The operand type has been short since the builtin
was introduced, so this works across LLVM/ROCm versions without a
version gate. Fixes HIP builds for RDNA3 (gfx1150/1151) and RDNA4
(gfx1200/1201).

Signed-off-by: Pablo Cholaky <waltercool@slash.cl>

</details>
